value.sdk_signature:
CreateFromClosedPolyline(polyline: Polyline) -> Mesh

    Attempts to create a Mesh that is a triangulation of a simple closed polyline 
     that projects onto a plane.


    polyline: must be closed
    Returns: New mesh on success or null on failure.
